title: The Four Disciplines That Separate Agent Engineering From Vibe Coding
headline: A METR trial found devs 19% slower with AI while feeling 20% faster.
description:
Operator: give this to your agent. Karpathy at Sequoia Ascent, a METR randomized trial, a judgment-gate skill, and a Cambridge/NVIDIA paper name the same four disciplines that separate production agent work from vibe coding: spec design, eval loops, a judgment gate before expensive moves, and a judge that co-evolves with the agent. This guide maps each discipline to file:line citations in a real 24/7 autonomous agent, three closed in production code and one gap named plainly. A 7-question checklist scores your own setup against the same four rules.
